completed_a48_prerequisite.checks: Exact supplied SHA, original protocol, finished_utc, final phase, all 80 slots and 32 waves explicitly terminal/unexecuted with reasons; all previously started original controllers reaped. Known A48 product failures do not block recording a diagnostic, and are not rewritten.
completed_a48_prerequisite.pin_state: Caller must supply the SHA only after the current A48 run is terminal and its complete outcome has been reviewed; no automatic discovery, hash substitution, retry or readiness wait.

diagnostic_completion_rule: All 20 original once-only writes and 8 waves finalized; original fixed setup policy (including an allowed framed kickoff product error and a mandatory successful one-shot warmup), DTO oracles, fixture integrity and original child cleanup succeed; all input/host gates remain valid; raw stderr capture/parse succeeds; no stop request. Known framed measured product errors remain explicit failed calls and may coexist with diagnostic_complete=true. all_measured_queries_successful and all_setup_queries_successful are reported separately. SteadyTrace absence remains reported rather than fabricated.
external_custody_adapter: Register the returned original Controller before start. A close-once adapter calls the original close unchanged and returns its exact result. Outer finally invokes it only if no close was previously attempted. No poll/wait/communicate, additional signal, reconstructed wait4 result or renewed cleanup budget is used. Any attempted close without complete evidence is retained as failure.
fixture_generator: synthetic i=1..65535: id=format(i%256,02x)+format(i+1,062x); owner=owners[i%4]; tool cycles host_list/host_health/file_info/effective_config by (i//4)%4; state cycles unknown/completed/failed by (i//16)%3; accepted_ms=1000000+i; elapsed=null for unknown, otherwise 1+i%1000. owner[0] is the real seed owner, others are SHA256 of a fixed synthetic-owner namespace plus that owner and index. Preserve the native seed record bytes as the 65536th record. Hot consists of that seed plus i=65025..65535.
host_gates: Original complete/no-busy host observation before and after the single controller and the original immediate premeasurement gate. No waiting out another workload, stopping foreign processes or memory availability threshold added.
layout: flat-v11 with the real seed-created original anchor; no synthesized shard anchor
originals_policy: Create-only private fixture and evidence. Retain exact original native seed, all 65535 synthetic record bytes, 512 hot copies, anchors, all wire bytes, raw errors, full per-slot costs, one complete per-file initial hash/identity map and complete subsequent revalidation digests. Collect only after measurement. Known disposable index cache bodies may be omitted with explicit inventory/receipts; never omit original records or failed calls.
purpose: Diagnose the existing A48 qualified ELF with its existing opt-in archive index phase timing; preserve and do not replace the complete A48 result.
qualification_and_input_fences: Require complete original six-stage qualification, both fresh=false source-bound compiler artifacts and actual complete source/log/executable bodies through the unchanged legacy loader. Verify guardian entry/worker flags and cross-receipts. Before and after the one controller, rehash source/ELF/test artifact/stage logs and all frozen helper, protocol, terminal-report, entry and worker inputs with original identity fences.

qualification_binding.qualification_state: all six newly completed A48 stages

reuse_contract: Load the pinned original module under a non-main name. Only replace the fixed env literal in controller_type.start by one added key. Remove that entry and assert AST equality of the complete controller_type; all other definition objects remain the originals in the same globals dictionary. The original main and ABBA summarize are never called.
scope_caveat: The extra trace environment variable changes logging and timing instrumentation. This single-candidate synthetic native-MCP diagnostic cannot replace or repair A48 failures, establish a performance improvement, or make multi-host, SSH-agent, power-loss or global optimization-limit claims.
trace_capture: After original child reap and close, re-read all original stderr (at most 64 MiB), require bytes/SHA/identity equal the original close receipt, retain it unchanged, parse strict existing steady_stage lines to a separate JSON. Preserve unmatched other existing trace formats in original stderr; parsing failures remain visible.
trace_scope: Existing SteadyTrace emits only when elapsed >100 ms and supplies no RPC/cohort member ID. Traces span setup, fixed idle/background work, measured requests and shutdown. No per-RPC or per-wave attribution, cohort count inference, clock conversion, summed-wall-time inference or missing-trace-as-zero inference.
work_budget_policy: One 600 s SIGALRM records the first stop in the same original module as TERM/INT; it does not asynchronously raise through spawn or close. Existing check_stop control points end further waves; original close and final fixture verification retain their frozen bounds. After controller cleanup, post-fences and trace capture, cancel this soft timer before taking final result snapshots; record the observation cutoff explicitly. Final report serialization and process exit remain covered by the caller, which must retain original owner custody and apply the fixed 900 s outer operation budget. This is not a promise of a hard kill exactly at 600 s; the script does not implement the outer 900 s owner itself.
